description: Seeded stochastic internal-variability control for the two-layer EBM. A piecewise-constant AR(1) heat-exchange perturbation is applied equal-and-opposite to the surface and deep reservoirs so it redistributes heat without directly sourcing or sinking total column heat.
stochastic_policy: At each fixed interval, update the exchange flux by xi_next = rho*xi + sigma*sqrt(1-rho^2)*epsilon with epsilon ~ N(0,1), then hold xi_next constant over the interval. The same signed flux enters the surface storage equation positively and the deep storage equation negatively.
statistics_policy: After the fixed burn-in, compute state mean, zero-lag covariance, and one-step lag covariance using population normalization. Representation diagnostics use only fixture-declared linear observation maps and their fixed Moore-Penrose pseudoinverses; no statistical model is fit.
interpretation_boundary: The AR(1) exchange process is a synthetic internal-variability control, not a calibrated ocean-atmosphere noise model. Statistics-preservation results apply only to this declared process and representation family.
